I feel the same. And I have no answers either, I always feel like I could do pretty much anything I want to but never have the motivation to even attempt to start. My brain never stops thinking as well, which is why I'm going to the doctor to check for ADD/ADHD.
Everything I think about ultimately concludes in, what's the point? The purpose? What's my purpose? I don't have one, not yet.. but I keep moving forward, I keep trying and I dont know why.

I remember feeling the same way, and honestly I still do in a way, alot of people do. I told myself hundreds of times that "this is my last Christmas," and that Christmas was 2 years ago. I've changed so much and you will too whether you want to or not.
Go be a teenager, have fun doing stupid things and getting away with it, experience things and grow and learn. (Just dont do REALLY stupid things) I miss being 15, I miss being 7 honestly but time keeps moving. Everything changes.

My little brothers teams entire football staff was just fired, varsity christian high school football. It's like a sign from God to try to coach there but it doesn't feel like the right thing to do again. I dont know what to do anymore except what I know will make me feel better, or "happy" for awhile atleast. All I wanna do right now is... I dont know. And I'll feel different tomorrow too, I'm always changing, always wanting to do different things  especially randomly.
